name: Cheatham County, Tennessee (United States)
description: A red canton bearing a blue disc with a white map of the county within a white ring, surrounded by white stars, and a fly of blue, white and blue horizontal stripes.
history: Cheatham County is a county located in Tennessee. The flag was adopted in 1995 (chosen by the county historical association from residents' designs and adopted by the County Commission in July 1995, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: disc with a white map of the county in a white ring
